--- layout: default type_slug: dumbbell title: Dumbbell Chart in C# — Before-and-After Dot Plots as SVG nav_title: Dumbbell Chart description: Build dumbbell and dot-plot charts in C# with AddDumbbell and RangePoint — before/after comparison per category as self-contained SVG. permalink: /chart/types/dumbbell/ doc_section: Chart Reporting doc_section_url: /chart/ generated_by: scripts/split_showcase.py --- {% capture specimen %} {% endcapture %} {% capture snippet %}{% highlight csharp %}{% raw %} using TerraFluent.Chart.Reporting.Models; string svg = ChartBuilder.Create() .Title("Salary Change After Promotion") .Size(700, 420) .XAxis("Role", "Junior","Mid","Senior","Lead","Principal") .YAxis("Salary ($k)", min: 0) .AsAnimated() .Series(s => s .AddDumbbell("Before → After", new[] { new RangePoint( 60, 72), new RangePoint( 85, 100), new RangePoint(110, 132), new RangePoint(140, 168), new RangePoint(175, 210), }, cfg => cfg.Color(ChartColor.ChartBlue))) .RenderToSvg(); {% endraw %}{% endhighlight %}{% endcapture %} {% include chart-type-page.html slug=page.type_slug specimen=specimen snippet=snippet %}
